questions.q: Where does Export live on a report's run page?
options: Under the Edit dropdown
Inside the report's filter panel
Only accessible through the Setup menu
It requires installing a separate app
questions.explain: Export is found under the Edit dropdown on the report run page, the same entry point regardless of the report's format.

questions.q: Which export format keeps groupings, subtotals, and a chart image close to what's shown on screen?
options: Details Only (.csv)
Formatted Report (.xlsx)
Both formats preserve this equally
Neither format preserves any formatting
questions.explain: Formatted Report produces an .xlsx file that keeps the on-screen layout, including subtotals and a chart image. Details Only strips all of that into flat rows.

questions.q: Why would someone choose Details Only instead of Formatted Report when sending data to another tool?
options: Details Only is the only format that includes a chart
Flat rows with no subtotals or merged cells are far easier to re-pivot or load elsewhere
Formatted Report files can't be opened outside Salesforce
Details Only automatically updates on a schedule
questions.explain: Details Only gives every underlying record as plain rows, which is exactly the shape most external tools (pivot tables, other databases) need — a formatted export's subtotal rows and merged cells get in the way.

questions.q: When does the CSV export's encoding setting actually matter?
options: Every single export, regardless of content
Only when exporting a Matrix report
When the data contains accented names or non-English characters that come out garbled
It has no effect on the exported file
questions.explain: The default encoding works for most English-language data. It only needs changing when non-ASCII characters aren't displaying correctly in the destination application.

questions.q: A manager needs the same report pulled every Monday morning and emailed to the team. What's the better long-term approach instead of manually exporting it each week?
options: Keep exporting it manually; there's no alternative
Set up a report subscription with Attach File turned on
Change the report's format to Joined
Delete and recreate the report each week
questions.explain: A recurring need is exactly what subscriptions are for. A subscription with Attach File enabled delivers the same file automatically on a schedule, replacing the manual export habit entirely.
